body.p: When validation problems are displayed in the Results pane, you can right-click on a problem and use the AI Positron Fix action to ask the AI Positron platform for help with fixing the problem. The AI Positron Fix action makes edits and explores additional content in the document if further context is needed. You can also use it on multiple selected validation problems to resolve all selected issues in a single operation.
body.note: The AI Positron Fix action is also available in the Quick Fix menu and in the tooltip when hovering over a validation issue in both the Text and Author modes.
